services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: “Surrounded by flowers with views of the Gore Range and Golden Peak, this venue is unforgettable.” The most unique venue in Vail, Colorado for your special day or next event. A picturesque & serene location just a short walk from Vail Village, perfect for a cozy welcome party on the Rooftop Terrace, photos at the base of the waterfall or intimate elopement surrounded by flowers within the aspen trees. Hosting your event here directly supports the mission of Betty Ford Alpine Gardens. Support a local nonprofit while making lifelong memories. services.name: Garden Tours
services.desc: Winter transforms our trails into a peaceful, snow-covered escape, and from January 5 through March 27, our snowshoe program invites visitors to experience that magic up close. Whether you prefer to explore at your own pace on a self-guided adventure or learn along the way with one of our guides on a guided snowshoe tour, there’s a winter experience here for every type of wanderer. Bundle up, breathe in the crisp mountain air, and discover the quiet beauty that only winter can reveal. Recommend for ages 5+.
